title: Menstrual Cramps
subtitle: Definitions, common causes, evidence-based management, and safety related to menstrual cramps.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports the role of prostaglandins in menstrual cramps and efficacy of NSAIDs and hormonal contraceptives for primary dysmenorrhea. Complementary therapies have moderate or emerging evidence. Secondary dysmenorrhea requires targeted diagnosis and management based on underlying pathology.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
